title: Foggy
description: This project adds a omniscient fear feeding fog monster named Foggy! This creature adds a fear factor to the game to spice up vanilla experience without mods.
body:
Foggy is a horror datapack for Minecraft 26.1.2 that layers an escalating Attention system over supernatural manifestations. The deeper you linger in darkness, rain, and underground tunnels, the more the fog schemes; rolling through four tense tiers of events: ambient dread, doors moving on their own, lights snuffing out, phantom strikes, corrupted food, false sounds, and finally The Watcher. It stays light on resources, and every manifestation can be force-tested via the debug commands so you can double-check every effect.

Installation:
1) Drop the datapack zip into `/saves/<World>/datapacks/`
2) Run `/reload`
3) Confirm with `/datapack list`
4) Run `/function foggy:config` to customize settings

Quick Verification:
After installing, run `/function foggy:test` to verify the datapack is working correctly, or use `/function foggy:status` to check your current attention and dread levels with helpful feedback.

Debug Commands:
- `/function foggy:status` - Check your attention/dread levels with emoji-based feedback
- `/function foggy:test` - Diagnostic test to verify the system is working
- `/tag @s add foggy.debug` - Enable debug overlay for detailed information

Configuration:
The full configuration menu includes shortcuts for intensity, volume, streamer toggles, dread panel (enable/disable, multiplier tiers, decay speeds, and radius presets), ambient events, echo whispers, and ritual bell features.

Streamer Mode:
Streamer Mode feeds action-bar updates showing total and per-player dread, with warnings before jump scares to help content creators prepare their audience.

For a detailed changelog please check the Github Repository
